To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Norwegian fuel cells and related technology projects were characterized by a lack of a coherent innovation system and a lack of a common innovation goal.

the fuel cells and related technology in the period 1990-02 has been characterized by: 1) a large number of inventions that were patented; 2) an overall lack of innovation; and 3) a failure to develop the technology in a way that would have been useful in the market.
the development of the fuel cell technology in Norway has been a failure in an innovation system perspective.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How has fuel cells and related technology been understood and developed in Norway?
the following questions: What are the characteristics of the innovation system in the field of fuel cell and related hydrogen technology?
how the development of fuel cells has been affected by innovation policy and how the innovation system has evolved over time.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the innovation policy of the Norwegian government was not very successful.
the policy of promoting the development of fuel cells in Norway has not been successful.
the policy initiatives have been too short-sighted, too focused on a single technology, too technology-driven and too focused on the short term.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Norwegian government's policy for the development of fuel cells was not successful, but the policy for the development for hydrogen technology was successful.
the fuel cells technology in Norway has been developed in a system failure context.
the fuel cells technology in Norway has not developed in an innovation system perspective.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the innovation system in this sector was not able to cope with the complexity of the innovation process, resulting in a number of failed projects.
a systemic perspective on innovation policy is important to understand and explain innovation processes in emerging fields.
the Norwegian fuel cells innovation system has been characterized by a number of systemic failures.
